events.title: LumberBoy is joining Steam Next Fest this October!
events.summary: LumberBoy is joining Steam Next Fest! {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46286450/23059d94f3e7adc4add9147658dbff598d7b2545.png Hi everyone, we're HiddenStageGames. LumberBoy is taking part in Steam Next Fest this October. When: October 19 – 26, 10am PDT LumberBoy is an incremental game about chopping trees. You cut wood, process it, sell it, and spend the money on upgrades. Then you go cut more wood, faster. It starts with one guy and one axe, and it gets out of hand fairly quickly. Free Demo Around 40 minutes

events.title: Demo Update - New Languages & Improved Language Selection
events.summary: New Languages Added Polish, Turkish, Spanish (Latin America), Italian, Ukrainian, Czech, Indonesian, and Vietnamese. The existing Spanish option is now labeled "Spanish (Spain)". Language Selection Improvements Fixed an issue where some languages (German, French, Portuguese, Spanish, Russian) were not shown on the language selection screen at first launch. events.title: Demo Update - Log Swap System & Forest Results Screen Overhaul
events.summary: Forest Results Screen Overhaul The forest expedition results screen now shows the loot you collected during the run. New: Log Swap System When your inventory or cargo crate is full, you can now empty a slot of cheaper logs to make room for more valuable ones. Swap key: Tab (keyboard) / Y (△) (gamepad). You can change it in the options. Improvements & Changes Gameplay & Balance Increased the damage of the Shockwave ability. Improved the visuals and visibility of the Greenreach Forest terrain tile
